night: The night holds together. Who, where and when stand up as one thing.
That group is confirmed: the hour, the place and the person fit what you have written down.
Stamped. The night, as you have it, is the night.
act: The act is confirmed: the wound and the hands that could have made it agree.
Stamped. How it was done and who could have done it stand together.
That group is confirmed. The means and the wound tell one story.
reason: The reason is confirmed: what they wanted and what was done are the same thing.
Stamped. The why and the who fit, and your notes carry it.
That group is confirmed. It was never only about the night.

night: Not yet supported. The sheet does not hold the night together yet.
Not yet supported. Something on this line will not take weight.
The stamp stays blank on the night. Not yet supported.
act: Not yet supported. The act is not nailed down.
Not yet supported. The stamp will not take on this line.
The stamp stays blank on the act. Not yet supported.
reason: Not yet supported. The reason does not hold yet.
Not yet supported. The ink will not dry on this line.
The stamp stays blank on the reason. Not yet supported.

open: Fill in every line of the group first.
There are still blanks on this group.
A group needs all its lines before it can be checked.

murder: Charged with murder. Every part of the sheet stands, and the Sheriff has nothing to add.
The sheet is complete and the charge is the full one. Murder.
killing: Charged with unlawful killing. The night is proved; the rest is not yet, and the charge is only what you can support.
A lesser charge, and an honest one: unlawful killing. Bring the rest to the trial if you can.
held: Held on suspicion. One part of the sheet stands and the rest does not, so the law will hold them and no more.
Held. The Sheriff will sign for a hold on what you can support and nothing larger.
unconfirmed: No part of the sheet is confirmed. You may still lay a charge on your own judgement, and answer for it if it fails.
Nothing is stamped. A charge now is a guess with a badge on it.

no_cause: The Sheriff will not take a name on this. Two kinds of proof first, and enough of each.
theory_none: Nothing in your notebook contradicts the sheet. That does not make it true.
You go through it line by line and find no seam. A sheet without a seam can still be wrong.
No contradiction turns up in the notes. Only in the world, if at all.
theory_open: You test the sheet against the notebook. These are the places it pulls:
You lay the sheet over your notes and hold it to the light. It pulls here:

tape: The tape from {cam} has not been watched for {band}.
Nobody has sat through the {cam} footage for {band}.
alibi: {n} has not said where they were that night.
Nobody has asked {n} for their evening, and {n} has not volunteered it.
hour: Your notes say nothing about {band} on {street}. Somebody was up and about.
place: You have not been to {place}, and your notes keep turning toward it.
{place} is named in your notes and you have never stood at its door.
friend: Nobody has told you who {v} was close to.
You know where {v} died and very little about who {v} had been.
none: Your notebook has no obvious holes. That is not the same as having none.
You find nothing missing on paper. The gaps may be the kind paper does not show.

lead_hedge: It might be the hour either side.
Your gut is not sure of the hour, and says so.
That is only a feeling about where to look, and feelings are often a little off.
It could be a street over. It could be nothing.
lead_more: There may be more than that, but it will not come clear.
Something else is in there with it, just out of reach.
hunch_out: You are out of hunches for this file. A new case, or a new level, will bring them back.
theory_cost: You spend the best part of an hour at the desk with the notebook and a pencil.
pattern: The reason stays blank. But the same sign at more than one scene is a pattern, and the state will take the pattern in a killer's motive's place.
Not yet supported. No one knows why. The same sign at two scenes is enough for the court to charge the whole thing.
